item.description: For almost two weeks, demonstrators have taken to the streets of New Delhi demanding the resignation of India's election commissioner. Here's what you need to know about it. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Riot squad called to Sydney's inner west after gunman flees
item.description: A police operation has been launched in Sydney's inner west after a man was reportedly seen with a gun. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Australia hands Ming dynasty Buddha back to China amid ongoing mystery over its arrival
item.description: A 500-year-old Buddha statue that was found buried by a roadside in Australia has been returned to China, leaving an ongoing mystery about how it arrived in the country. The 15cm (six-inch) bronze figurine was formally handed over to Chinese consular representatives during a ceremony in the coastal town of Denham in Shark Bay on Tuesday, the public broadcaster ABC reported. It will be taken to China for further evaluation to establish its history before being displayed at a museum in... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Caroline Lin

item.title: Shooting at elementary school in Oregon leaves at least five dead
item.description: Authorities believe at least five people died in a shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon, on Thursday, according to law enforcement officials. Police confirmed the suspect was dead and said children were among the victims. Publicado también por: Sky News - World, ABC News Australia, France 24 - English. Fuente: The Hindu - International.

item.title: Cowan handed AFL suspension following illicit substance investigation
item.description: The AFL hands down its sanction to Lachie Cowan following an investigation into his use of an illicit substance last weekend. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Mayor says flood-prone airstrip may need to move despite $27m upgrade
item.description: A Gulf of Carpentaria Mayor is calling for a newly repaired airstrip to be relocated to avoid future disasters. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Abbey Halter and Tim Little

item.title: Sandalwood industry left in limbo as WA government mulls new rules
item.description: Producers say Western Australia's lucrative sandalwood industry faces an uncertain future, as the state government reviews the regulations governing the harvest of the valuable wood. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Nicholas R Ward

item.title: Chickens allowed free range again in Victoria as bird flu lockdown ends
item.description: Bird welfare concerns and forecast hot temperatures influenced the decision to ease confinement rules for flocks of 50 or more birds. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Justine Longmore

item.title: Supercars to return to Phillip Island, plugging hole left by MotoGP exit
item.description: The Victorian government has announced a five-year deal to bring the Supercars to Phillip Island, helping offset an $80 million loss caused by losing the MotoGP. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Madeleine Stuchbery

item.title: Mums get back to nature for mental and physical reboot
item.description: Most mothers' groups typically meet at a park or cafe, but a bunch of Queensland mums are stepping it up a notch. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jessica Ross

item.title: Royal Children's Hospital handed $66m after fear new beds would sit empty
item.description: Premier Ben Carroll's funding announcement comes after hospital staff claimed new hospital beds would be empty because there were not enough workers to support them. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Complex surgery successfully separates Fijian conjoined twins
item.description: In what was described as an "exceptionally rare" case, doctors in Saudi Arabia say a complex operation to separate 13-month-old Fijian conjoined twins has been successful. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Lice Movono and Evan Wasuka

item.title: Town's only unleaded service station cuts fuel supply over rising costs
item.description: The owner of the only unleaded fuel pumps in a regional Victorian town has left the town dry for almost a month, saying it is struggling to cover the increasing cost of fuel and the business's day-to-day expenses. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Tamara Clark

item.title: New Victorian laws reveal auction reserves, so buyers stop wasting weekends
item.description: The real estate industry says new laws targeting agents underquoting a house price are well-intentioned but poorly designed. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Tasmania's Jewels enter WNBL with debut win over Geelong
item.description: The Tasmania Jewels have won their debut clash against the Geelong Venom in front of a sell-out crowd in Hobart. Coach Claudia Brassard has praised the players for prolific defence and sharp shooting. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Reassembling John Travolta's jet down to nuts and 5,400 bolts stage
item.description: The old luxury jet movie star John Travolta donated to a NSW aviation museum is being painstakingly reassembled on site. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Five killed in Houthi strike on presidential palace in Aden
item.description: Witnesses report at least six explosions near palace used by Yemen's internationally recognized government At least six explosions struck on Thursday near the palace used by Yemen ’s internationally recognized government in the port city of Aden, witnesses said. An official told the Associated Press that at least two people were killed, and Iran -backed Houthi rebels based in northern Yemen quickly claimed responsibility. Government military sources in Yemen told Agence-France Press (AFP) that at least four people were killed and 10 wounded. Continue reading... Publicado también por: The Guardian - World, Al Jazeera English. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Police investigating death of 5-year-old boy at home in Grafton
item.description: A post-mortem will be conducted on a five-year-old boy to try to establish how he died inside his Grafton home on Monday. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Global sugar prices rally amid key producer Brazil's presidential election
item.description: The rally has brought relief to Australian farmers, who faced months of uncertainty as input costs rose. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Sydney prison criticised for 'putrid' conditions returns to public hands
item.description: Parklea Correctional Centre houses more than 1,500 inmates, ranging from minimum to maximum security with most on remand waiting for their court cases to be finalised. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
